ov: A forest animal of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with zebra-like stripes on its legs but a close relative of the giraffe. The okapi and giraffe are the only living members of their family.
rg: North-eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.

cf.tip: The okapi is the giraffe’s only living relative.
Despite the striped legs, the okapi isn’t related to zebras.

fx: Males have short, horn-like bumps on the head, like a giraffe’s.
